hide_src: D, Oct. 10, 2026: the page's own media list (below) replaces the hide list; the eight repeats it hid stay out, with the rest D cut.
media_src: D, Oct. 10, 2026 (Checkpoint 3b): the page rebuilt after the Brand Bible, the work straight on the paper. The signature written on, first, looping (Final Assets/Video/SB-Video-Logo-Script-16x9-White.mp4, 7.5 to 13 s: the book, then the script, before the film's closing credit; cropped, its white mapped to the paper, no sound); the book drawn by hand (03 Source/Sketches/Hand drawing/SB-Book-Drawing-Timelapse.mov, cut before its last clean frame and fade, cropped to the drawing, twice the speed, its white mapped to the site's paper and under the grain); the fourteen marks, numbered and labeled with the Bible's words and sizes (transparent PNGs from 01 Deliverables/Final Assets/Logos, copied at 1600 px); the six colors as plain swatches with the Bible's names and roles; in use, the tote, the cap and the tags, then the announcement film.
